speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with acute diarrhea; to determine the cause, how long has your diarrhea been occurring and have you noticed any blood or mucus in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-Associated Diarrhea (Clostridioides difficile infection)

Given the history of recent levofloxacin treatment for pneumonia and the onset of severe watery diarrhea (9 episodes in 2 days) with cramping, I suspect C. diff. Do you have any fever or recent hospitalization/antibiotic use at a different facility? I will also order a stool test to confirm.
